title: Draw Stacking
description: MAY-DIFFER (spec 12.4): legacy pending_draws is rebuilt on response windows. A draw-penalty (+2/+4) play opens a window for the other seats (`responders` `@others`, which includes `@next_player`, eligible via the `stackable` tag, env duration). The response route marks the stack and the ENGINE performs the two spec-12.4 halves the DAG cannot express: it appends the response card's own N to the then-target's vanilla:draw_debt status and re-opens the window (`reopen`), so the chain keeps one budget ledger. The default route draws the accumulated debt on the current target (`draw_cards` with `n_from_debt`) and clears the status. The match_start allow rescues the out-of-turn stackable response from vanilla:turn_order (the spec 13.3 deny/allow pattern). The legacy golden must be compared with may_differ honoured.
